title: Our Class Pet
text: Our class officially got a new pet hamster this week! We named him Peanut. "Can I hold him?" I asked. "Sure!" said my teacher. Peanut is very soft and really cute. At first, he ran away quickly and hid in his little house. "Maybe he is scared," my friend said. We waited quietly, and then Peanut came out again. "Is he still hiding?" someone asked. "No, he is not hiding anymore," I said. "Yes, he wants to play!" We took turns holding Peanut together. I fed him a piece of carrot too. Everyone was very happy. "Can we feed him again tomorrow?" I asked. "Sure, we can!" said my teacher.
